name: Transforming Your Heart
overview: Scripture reveals that transforming the heart is a divine work where God creates a clean heart and renews a right spirit within us, replacing a stony heart with one of flesh (Psalms 51:10; Ezekiel 36:26). Believers are called to trust the Lord wholeheartedly and guard their hearts diligently, recognizing that the heart governs the course of life (Proverbs 3:5; 4:23). This transformation is rooted in the eternal Word, who is God, and calls for a life surrendered as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God (John 1:1; Romans 12:1).
